cards.ex: She's so down-to-earth, despite her fame.
cards.exUz: U shu qadar mashhur bo'lishiga qaramay, juda soddadil.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, maqtanchoq emas, real hayotga yaqin odam.

cards.ex: My grandfather is very set in his ways and refuses to use a smartphone.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom o'z bildigidan qolmaydi va smartfondan foydalanishni istamaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlaridan voz kechishni xohlamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's a real people person and makes everyone feel comfortable.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy kirishimli odam va hamma o'zini qulay his qilishiga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan oson til topisha oladigan odam.

cards.ex: You need to be thick-skinned to survive in this industry.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada omon qolish uchun siz betalvash bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidni oson qabul qila oladigan, ta'sirlanmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He has a soft spot for stray animals and always tries to help them.
cards.exUz: Uning daydi hayvonlarga zaif nuqtasi bor va u har doim ularga yordam berishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir yoki kimdirga bo'lgan maxsus mehr.

cards.ex: You need to get your act together if you want to pass this exam.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tartibga solmoq, ishlarini to'g'ri yo'lga qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: The actor's personality was larger than life, both on and off screen.
cards.exUz: Aktyorning shaxsi ekranda ham, undan tashqarida ham juda mashhur edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda taniqli va qiziqarli shaxs.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and always puts others before herself.
cards.exUz: Uning yuragi oltindan va u har doim boshqalarni o'zidan oldin qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon va saxiy odam.

cards.ex: He's a very easygoing person and doesn't get stressed easily.
cards.exUz: U juda beqayg'u odam va osonlik bilan stressga tushmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan kelisha oladigan, stressga berilmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's a very strong-willed woman and doesn't give up easily.
cards.exUz: U juda irodali ayol va osonlik bilan taslim bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iyatli, o'z maqsadiga erishish uchun harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a bit of a character, but everyone loves him.
cards.exUz: U biroz g'alatiroq, lekin uni hamma yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xos, biroz g'alati odam.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength, so it's easy to work together.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim fikri bir joydan chiqamiz, shuning uchun birga ishlash oson.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan oson kelishadigan, fikrlari mos keladigan odamlar.

cards.ex: He seems like a cold fish, but he's actually very kind.
cards.exUz: U sovuq odamga o'xshaydi, lekin aslida juda mehribon.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularini ko'rsatmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a people pleaser, she always says yes to everything.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik xushomadgo'yki, har doim hamma narsaga ha deydi.
cards.uzDef: Hammaga yoqishga harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Keep your chin up! Things will get better.
cards.exUz: Ruhingni tushirma! Hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlikka tushmaslik, yaxshi narsalarga umid qilish.

cards.ex: He has a quick temper, so be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: Uning tez jahli chiqadi, shuning uchun nima deyayotganingizga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan jahli chiqadigan odam.

cards.ex: She's always been a shoulder to cry on for me.
cards.exUz: U doim men uchun dardkash bo'lib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytda yordam beradigan, tasalli beradigan odam.

cards.ex: He may not be book smart, but he's definitely street smart.
cards.exUz: U kitob o'qimagan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u albatta aqlli.
cards.uzDef: Hayotiy tajribaga ega, vaziyatni tez anglaydigan odam.

cards.ex: She's book smart, but lacks practical experience.
cards.exUz: U o'qimishli, lekin amaliy tajribaga ega emas.
cards.uzDef: Kitobdan ko'p narsa o'rgangan, bilimli odam.

cards.ex: He has a short fuse, so you have to be careful around him.
cards.exUz: U tez alahlaydi, shuning uchun u bilan ehtiyot bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezda jahli chiqadigan odam.

cards.ex: She wears her heart on her sleeve, so you always know how she feels.
cards.exUz: U o'z his-tuyg'ularini ochiq ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun har doim uning qanday his qilayotganini bilasiz.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini ochiq ko'rsatadigan odam.

cards.ex: He always calls a spade a spade, even if it's not what people want to hear.
cards.exUz: U har doim rostini aytadi, hatto odamlar eshitishni xohlamasa ham.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, qo'rqmasdan aytmoq.

cards.ex: He turned out to be a fair-weather friend when I needed help.
cards.exUz: U menga yordam kerak bo'lganda vaqtinchalik do'st bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi paytlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a tough nut to crack, but once you get to know him, he's great.
cards.exUz: U qiyin odam, lekin uni bilsangiz, u ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish, kelishish qiyin bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: He's a lone wolf and prefers to work independently.
cards.exUz: U yakka bo'ri va mustaqil ishlashni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'zi yolg'iz ishlashni afzal ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed with her, she stood her ground.
cards.exUz: Hamma unga qarshi bo'lsa ham, u o'z fikrida turdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikridan qaytmaslik, pozitsiyasini himoya qilish.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile to help her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun ko'proq harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinganidan ko'proq harakat qilmoq, qo'shimcha ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: Sometimes it's best to turn the other cheek and not escalate the conflict.
cards.exUz: Ba'zida boshqa yuzni burish va mojarani kuchaytirmaslik yaxshiroqdir.
cards.uzDef: Xafa qilganga javob qaytarmaslik, kechirish.

cards.ex: His constant complaining really gets under my skin.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari meni asabiylashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir g'ashiga tegmoq, bezovta qilmoq.

cards.ex: She has a good head on her shoulders and always makes wise decisions.
cards.exUz: U aqlli va har doim dono qarorlar qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Aqlli, mantiqiy fikrlaydigan odam.
